caption: The drawing depicts a stylized human figure rendered in profile, facing right. The figure is holding a large, curved, dark brown bow in its left hand, with an arrow nocked, pointing to the left. The arrow is colored red with brown and white stripes on the shaft and a triangular red tip. The figure’s body is primarily dark brown with pink and red accents and decorations, including a wavy, zigzag pattern around the waist and neck area, as well as the lower hem. The figure’s visible leg is colored pink with red zigzag markings and dark brown bands near the knee and foot, while the other leg is dark brown with a pink shin guard that has two white dots. The right arm is dark brown, while the left arm is colored pink with red patterns. The head is light pink with red linear facial markings, and it is adorned with a large fan-shaped headdress of streaked red feathers extending backward. The background is plain, off-white, and bordered by a thin black line, with faint smudges of yellow in the corners. The drawing uses a limited palette of red, pink, dark brown, and light neutral tones.
title: Indian Weather Vane
